material_decisions.ruling: Both analyses resolve the same four mind and four stream positions. Prefer Tibetan-angle flat sems/rgyun/rgyud and nga/tsam, exposing the lexical units without capturing internal articles. The established compounds in the English proposal are not false; their correct members are retained as flat atoms instead. The English report misnames the second sems kyi rgyud as another sems kyi rgyun; actual resolved Tibetan slices are preserved.

material_decisions.topic: Full stream-relative recast versus rigs compound
material_decisions.ruling: Reject English p1 as unnecessarily broad, not as false polarity: direct HGM rigs 'dra includes continuation of later, similar instances, with tier glossary / HTG2016. Hopkins separately says similar type{BJ 58.6}. Retain this d5 and the unique d7 'dra/similar; rgyud separately owns stream #4. No atom claims what you mean by or its supplied participant.

Tibetan d3 btags pa/label being applied and English d5 btags pa/label both pass. Prefer the tighter directly HGM-attested label at d5; being applied is an explanatory verb phrase left unwrapped, with no absence-null.

Restore English ji ltar/How and de nyid/very thing from the Tibetan-angle omissions. de licenses the referential thing, nyid the emphatic very. sems/mind and nyid/itself remain separate, in the fourth mind context. kyang/also resolves to also #2, not the supplied also in It also goes on.

Reject res 'ga' ba'i bag chags as an unnecessarily broad d5 noun phrase. Keep bag chags/mental seeds #2 and the tighter HGM res 'ga' ba/occasions; particular is unpaired. Tighten sgo ba'i to sgo ba/stained and retain gzhir/basis with the bound terminative; no correction to sgo is justified.

Opening 'o na/question framing, yin zhe na, la brten nas, genitives not separately represented, causal/copular constructions and ces-pa ltar-na frame remain distributed. No absent exponent is asserted. The source supplies no separate atom for planted, explanatory participants, first also or the quoted English pronouns/articles.
